description: This file defines the PersistableProductOption class, which extends ProductOptionEntity, implements Serializable, and manages a list of ProductOptionDescription objects.

classes.name: PersistableProductOption
classes.description: A class representing a persistable product option with descriptions, extending ProductOptionEntity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions for the product option.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions associated with the product option.
